name: Ultimate Metro (Prototype)
summary: Experimental surface tram terminus. Native reversal is not yet proven; test saves only.
description: Private prototype revision 5: two-track surface tram terminus with scissors crossover. Corrects inline snapping, subconstruction ground/terrain and platform midpoint references. Uses native tram reservation defaults; crossing safety is unproven. Connectivity and reversal still require in-game testing. Place two NEW crossover stations on a test save. Existing placed prototypes are not automatically rebuilt. No vehicle or world commands. Additional read-only probes inspect individual internal edges. Internal rails and catenary visuals remain unfinished. One vehicle only. Do not remove while constructions remain.
